name: Watabe Shiina
source: [url=/c41297]Sousuke's[/url] younger sister and one of [url=/c20285]Hazuki’s[/url] friends at the kindergarten who is very shy. She always carries around her stuffed animal with her wherever she goes. She greatly loves her Grandmother and won’t hesitate to repeat anything and everything that her [url=/c41298]Grandmother[/url] tells her, no matter how strange.
